prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic full-body studio fashion portrait of one original approved adult woman against a seamless pure-white background.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with long straight black hair slicked back, defined realistic features, clean editorial makeup, visible natural skin texture, calm self-assured direct gaze, and composed expression. She wears the supplied strapless black glossy latex or PVC crop top, matching high-waisted glossy shorts and thigh-high glossy boots.
composition_elements: Full-body pose with hands on hips, elbows slightly back, one leg gently bent and natural weight distribution.
Pure white seamless background with no distractions or artificial glow.
Preserve realistic latex tension, specular highlights, material creases, hair sheen, silhouette and confident editorial attitude.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft key light with controlled fill and broad specular reflections on latex, preserving natural contours and soft grounded shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 portrait, 70mm lens at f/5.6, realistic depth of field, visible pores, material texture and optical sharpness, slight grain, no CGI look, no text or watermark.
